name: layer
description: Layer skills: creative craft for AI game and entertainment asset generation.

plugins.name: 01.-getting-started
plugins.description: Connect to Layer and learn the generation loop every other skill builds on: model discovery, the spend gate, uploads, and polling.

plugins.name: 02.-direction
plugins.description: Agree a look before generating at volume: moodboards, storyboards, colour, era, and framing.

plugins.name: 03.-images
plugins.description: Generate stills and change the ones you already have: prompting, sizing, references, masked edits, reframing, upscaling, and layers.

plugins.name: 04.-game-art
plugins.description: Art that has to sit in a system: characters and casts, environments and parallax, game UI, pixel sprites and sheets, and seamless textures.

plugins.name: 05.-video-and-audio
plugins.description: Motion and sound: animating stills, camera and loops, sound effects, music, speech, and cutting shots into one finished video.

plugins.name: 06.-3d
plugins.description: Meshes for a game engine: generation from text or image, remeshing, retexturing, rigging, and animation.

plugins.name: 07.-consistency-and-pipelines
plugins.description: Hold one look across a whole project with trained reference sets, and run the Blueprint workflows a studio has already built.

plugins.name: 08.-review
plugins.description: Judge a batch before it ships: scoring rules, verdicts, and reviewing a set against the brief.
